text.tspan: Official AWS certification that validates cloud fundamentals: cloud
concepts, core services, security, architecture, pricing and support. It
is the first step on the AWS certification path.
Hands-on exam in a live AWS environment, with timed challenges built on a
business scenario: application delivery, performance optimization and
Solutions to scale connectivity, connect on-premises networks and protect
applications, with hands-on practice in tunnels, peering, inter-region
routing, traffic filtering and mirroring, and log analysis.
My first AWS badge: building hands-on solutions with compute, networking,
database and security services, applying the core concepts of the cloud.
Represented Brazil in Intelligent Security Technology and finished 5th in
the world: planning, installing and maintaining systems that protect
